name: virtual-anchor-monorepo

scripts.//test:e2e: Builds with `build:trace`, not `build`, because the momentum spec now asserts on the library's own trace stream — which names *why* each scroll write did or did not happen, where a write counter could only say that one did. The rest of the suite is unaffected: with no listener installed, `trace()` returns on its first line.
scripts.//perf: The scroll benchmark. Builds the demo *without* instrumentation — unlike `test:e2e`, which needs `build:trace` to read the trace stream — because measuring frame time on an instrumented build measures the instrumentation. Local only, and deliberately not in CI: see perf/playwright.perf.config.ts.
scripts.perf: pnpm --filter demo build && playwright test -c perf/playwright.perf.config.ts
scripts.release: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && changeset publish
scripts.check:package: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && node scripts/check-package.mjs

//typescript: Pinned to 6.0.x, not `latest`. TypeScript 7 is out and the library compiles against it cleanly, but typescript-eslint refuses to load with it and typedoc caps at 6.0.x — so "latest" would cost type-aware linting, which has caught more defects in this project than any other tool. Revisit when typescript-eslint ships TS 7 support: https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940
//pnpm: esbuild is held at >=0.28.1 because vite still pins 0.27.7, which has a dev-server file-read advisory (GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr). Dev-only and not part of the published package, but there is no reason to carry it. Remove the override once vite ships 0.28.x.
